title: After Impact
overview: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.

videos.name: Would You Survive an ASTEROID IMPACT?

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

videos.name: Will They Survive the Quest? Treasure Trekkers Official Trailer Drop

title: Love of Your Life
overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
overview: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

videos.name: Drishyam: The Conclusion - Official Trailer | Ajay Devgn, Tabu, Jaideep | Abhishek Pathak | 2 Oct

title: A Talent for Murder
overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: You+Me - Against the World
overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
overview: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

title: One Last Shot
overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: Mouse
overview: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: Doing Life
overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

title: Days of Thunder 2
overview: The sequel to the 1990 film. Plot TBA.

title: UNABOMBER
overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

title: Possible Love
overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
overview: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go awry when a wild beast appears in the woods.

title: You Can't Leave
overview: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.

videos.name: You Can't Leave (October 2026) | Official Short Trailer

title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
overview: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

title: Club Kid
overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

title: Ghost Market
overview: Hidden away in a remote location on Oahu's North Shore is 'Ono Market, a plate lunch shop that serves lost spirits, stuck between life and death. The living have never set foot in this place - until a food-loving, would-be content creator named Kyle blunders in, eats a mixed plate for the dead, and accidentally turns himself into a half-ghost. To get back to normal, he'll have to deal with paranormal deliveries, long hours in a haunted kitchen, and scariest of all... his own family.

title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: Victorian Psycho
overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

title: Matchbox the Movie
overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

title: Daffy Season
overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

videos.name: A global celebration of soccer. A personal crisis for Daffy.

title: The Mongoose
overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

title: The Weight
overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

title: Shrek 5
overview: Shrek and Donkey team up for another whirlwind, big-city adventure, this time in the magical city of Further Further Away.

title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
overview: A dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.

title: The Whistler
overview: Reeling from their daughter's loss, Nicole and Sebastian come into possession of a secluded Venezuelan farm, unaware of the dark forces they're about to face.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
overview: When a new threat emerges from a fractured timeline, Team Sonic find themselves facing an adventure unlike anything they've encountered before. With the Chaos Emeralds scattered across different periods in time, Sonic—alongside new friends and old—must journey through the past, present, and future to recover them before a dangerous alternate timeline becomes reality.

title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA—Live!
overview: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their new-found freedom in an unforgiving wilderness. When Joshua is called to replace Moses as their faithful leader, tensions mount in the midst of dwindling supplies and approaching armies. With one last fortified city standing between the Israelites and the Promised Land, unexpected help emerges from behind enemy lines and Joshua's trust in God's plan is put to the ultimate test.  Filmed in front of a live audience, this special event invites you to experience one of the most redemptive stories of the Bible come to life like never before!
